user.title: Malaysia Weather
user.description: Set up Malaysia Weather. This first creates the nationwide Warnings & Imagery entry.

location.title: Add weather location
location.description: Choose a location to add its 7-day forecast. Optionally add a MET Malaysia API key for English forecasts, the state, coordinates and, if MET granted it, live observations.

data_description.api_key: Token from api.met.gov.my. Leave empty to use data.gov.my only.

error.invalid_api_key: MET Malaysia rejected this API key
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MET Malaysia to check the API key. Try again later.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach data.gov.my. Try again later.
abort.cannot_configure: The Warnings & Imagery entry has no options. You can only delete it.

init.title: Location and MET API key
init.description: Choose the location for this forecast, and optionally add, change or remove the MET Malaysia API key.

data_description.api_key: Token from api.met.gov.my. Clear it to go back to data.gov.my only.

marine.title: Marine area
marine.description: Optionally pick a MET marine area to add today's sea wind and wave height to this weather entity.

error.location_already_configured: That location is already set up as another entry
error.invalid_api_key: MET Malaysia rejected this API key
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MET Malaysia to check the API key. Try again later.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach data.gov.my. Try again later.
abort.cannot_configure: The Warnings & Imagery entry has no options. You can only delete it.

met_api_key_invalid.title: MET API key for {location} is not working
met_api_key_invalid.description:
MET Malaysia rejected the API key used by the {location} forecast. The forecast keeps working from data.gov.my, but the MET extras are off.

Go to **Settings > Devices & services > Malaysia Weather**, open **{location}**, select **Configure**, and enter a new key or clear it.

met_unavailable.title: MET Malaysia is not responding for {location}
met_unavailable.description: Several requests to the MET Malaysia API failed in a row. The {location} forecast keeps working from data.gov.my; the MET extras come back on their own when MET recovers. If it continues, check the key under **Settings > Devices & services > Malaysia Weather > {location} > Configure**.
